title: 1986 Topps Dave Righetti New York Yankees #560 - Set Of 2
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of 2 1986 Topps Dave Righetti New York Yankees trading cards (#560). These vintage baseball cards feature the player Dave Righetti from the New York Yankees and were manufactured by Topps in 1986. The cards are original and part of the Topps set, making them a valuable collectible for baseball fans and trading card enthusiasts. These 3½" x 2½" cards are a piece of baseball history from the 1986 season.
